d:
Some romantic melodies make the world fade away, leaving only the magic of love! Enjoy “Duniya Bhula Ke Bahon Mein Aake” from the Bollywood film Achanak, featuring Govinda and Manisha Koirala. With the soulful voices of Kumar Sanu and Alka Yagnik, this beautiful romantic duet is a lovely addition to your collection of nostalgic Hindi film songs.
Duniya Bhula Ke Bahon Mein Aake | Achanak (1998) | Manisha Koirala, Govinda | Kumar-Alka 90s Hits
Song: Duniya Bhula Ke Bahon Mein Aake
Movie: Achanak (1998)
Star Cast: Govinda & Manisha Koirala
Singers: Kumar Sanu & Alka Yagnik
